description:
NeuroHire is seeking a motivated and technically strong Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and customer problem-solving. This role is ideal for a recent graduate who enjoys building software solutions, understanding real-world business challenges, and working directly with customers to turn technical requirements into practical applications.
 The selected candidate will collaborate with engineering and product teams to develop, customize, deploy, and improve software solutions based on customer needs.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Work with customers to understand business challenges, technical requirements, and workflow needs.
 Design, develop, and deploy software solutions tailored to real-world use cases.
 Build integrations using APIs, databases, and third-party platforms.
 Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept applications to validate solutions.
 Collaborate with product and engineering teams to implement customer-specific requirements.
 Troubleshoot technical issues and improve application performance and reliability.
 Translate customer feedback into actionable product and engineering improvements.
 Document technical solutions, implementation processes, and project outcomes.
 Requirements 
 Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
 0–1 year of experience in software engineering, application development, or a related technical role.
 Strong programming fundamentals and knowledge of object-oriented programming.
 Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
 Understanding of REST APIs, web services, and application integrations.
 Basic knowledge of SQL, databases, and data structures.
 Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and software development workflows.
 Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
 Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities.
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
 Ability to work collaboratively with customers and cross-functional engineering teams.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Academic projects, internships, or practical experience building and deploying software applications.
 Exposure to AI/ML tools, LLMs, or generative AI applications.
 Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-based deployment.
 Experience building API integrations or automating business workflows.
 Interest in customer-facing engineering, technical consulting, or solution development.
 Benefits 
 Opportunity to work on real-world software and technology challenges.
 Hands-on exposure to software engineering, AI applications, and cloud technologies.
 Experience collaborating with customers and cross-functional engineering teams.
 Opportunities to develop technical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
 Professional development and long-term career growth opportunities.
